3.10 Sample Code and Model
In Listing 3.6 a blueprint for the components used in the Sensor/Actuator pattern is
provided. The blueprint code is not complete but just gives an idea how it is realized.
The composition component is not shown.
Please note that the AUTOSAR meta model requests that a sensor actuator component
type references a corresponding sensor or actuator, resp., using a HwDescriptio-
nEntity, [11]. In this case a HwElement is needed to be used. Since there is a
standardized HwCategory for sensors and actuators also a HwType is defined that is
referenced by the HwElement.
